purpose: A trail of links that shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy three or more levels deep, and lets the person go back up. The last item is the current page.

notFor.case: Hierarchies of one or two levels.
The primary navigation of the app.
Moving between pages of a result set.

Default.visual: Items joined by separators in Content/subtle; Appearance, Separator and Size cascade to every part.

a11y.keyboard: Tab moves through the item links and the ellipsis button; Enter follows a link. The current page is not focusable.
notes: nav aria-label="Breadcrumb" over an ordered list.
The current page is aria-current="page" and not a link; separators are hidden from assistive technology.

openQuestions: Trails longer than four items should collapse their start into a BreadcrumbEllipsis: does the component collapse automatically, or does the app decide?
